zh.title: Simple Flying：美擬再籌300億升級航管
zh.summary: Simple Flying報導美擬追加300億美元航管經費；因電信故障癱瘓東北空域
body: Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 22 日發布報導，標題指出美國在東北部空中交通管制系統因電信故障導致大面積癱瘓僅一天後，隨即提出再度追加 300 億美元經費以升級航管基礎設施。
報導摘要稱「The US wants another $30 billion for aviation upgrades after a telecom failure crippled Northeast air traffic.」，說明該筆龐大撥款旨在因應日益老舊的空管系統，但具體資金分配細節、國會立法審議時程以及具體執行計畫均未在報導中說明。

en.title: Simple Flying: US Seeks Another $30 Billion for ATC Upgrades After Northeast Meltdown
en.summary: Simple Flying reports US seeks $30B ATC upgrade funding after telecom failure cripples Northeast airspace
body: Simple Flying reported on September 22 that the United States is seeking an additional $30 billion for air traffic control upgrades, just one day after a telecommunications failure crippled Northeast air traffic operations.

The article's summary states: "The US wants another $30 billion for aviation upgrades after a telecom failure crippled Northeast air traffic.", indicating the funding aims to modernize aging infrastructure, though specific allocation details, congressional timelines, and implementation plans were not disclosed.

The report, titled "US Wants Another $30 Billion For ATC Upgrades 1 Day After Northeast ATC Meltdown," highlights the urgency of capital investment following the outage but does not specify the legislative vehicle or funding mechanism for the proposed appropriation.
